note: Official names, descriptions and grades are as PlayStation publishes them (via Exophase, cross-checked with PSNProfiles). Every guide is written in my own words for this entry and cites its sources; five trophies whose unlock method was still unconfirmed at launch say so plainly.

sourceList.name: GGRecon
sourceList.about: GTA 6 trophy list report — 55 trophies, Platinum needs 100%, GTABase on the possibly missable meditation trophy.

sourceList.about: GTA 6 Trophy List — the 27 visible and 28 hidden trophies, roadmap order, vague story trophies.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.missableNote: No. It pops the moment the other 54 are earned.
trophies.guide: Earn every other trophy in the game. There is no shortcut: the last ones to land are usually A Long Road (100% completion) and the final story mission, so the Platinum pops right after one of those two. All 55 trophies are offline single-player, so no online mode or DLC is ever needed.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.missableNote: No. Automatic story trophy, cannot be missed.
trophies.guide: Finish the first main mission of Chapter 1, Gone Fishing. It unlocks as soon as the mission ends, so just play the story from the start and it is yours within the opening hour.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.missableNote: No. Automatic story trophy, cannot be missed.
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1 of the story. It pops when the first main mission of Chapter 2 begins. While you are still in Chapter 1, do the one thing that can be lost: the morning balcony meditation at Jason's house (see Positive Mental Attitude) before the chapter ends.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.missableNote: No. Automatic story trophy, cannot be missed.
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2 of the story. It pops when the first main mission of Chapter 3 begins. Chapter 2 is where the game opens up: both characters become playable together after the mission Coffee Break, which unlocks most of the free-roam trophies.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.missableNote: No. Automatic story trophy, cannot be missed.
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3 of the story. It pops after the first two main missions of Chapter 4. Chapter 3 unlocks the big robbery systems (jewelry jobs, the Key Cloner, bank-vault tips), so start using them as they appear.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.missableNote: No. Automatic story trophy, cannot be missed.
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4 of the story. It pops after the final main mission of Chapter 4. From here the last chapter and the endgame cleanup are all that stand between you and the Platinum.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.missableNote: No. Automatic story trophy, cannot be missed.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of the story. It pops when the credits roll. After the story you keep free-roam of the whole map, and the 100% completion checklist opens under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.missableNote: No. Automatic story trophy, cannot be missed.
trophies.guide: Finish the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run. It unlocks during the story and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.missableNote: No. Automatic story trophy, cannot be missed.
trophies.guide: Finish the Chapter 3 main mission The Cartel Heist. It unlocks during the story and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.missableNote: No. Automatic story trophy, cannot be missed.
trophies.guide: Finish the Chapter 4 main mission Child's Play. It unlocks during the story and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.missableNote: No. Automatic story trophy, cannot be missed.
trophies.guide: Finish the Chapter 4 main mission Headliners. It unlocks during the story and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.missableNote: No. Automatic story trophy, cannot be missed.
trophies.guide: Finish the Chapter 4 main mission VCIA Takedown. It unlocks during the story and cannot be missed. The airport itself matters later too: stealing a docked airliner there is how Catch Me If You Can works.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.missableNote: No. Automatic story trophy, cannot be missed.
trophies.guide: Finish the Chapter 5 main mission Operation Savage Glory. It unlocks during the story and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.missableNote: No. Nothing on the 100% checklist is missable; everything can be finished in free-roam after the story.
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. The checklist opens after the story under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion, and progress made during the story already counts. The requirements are lenient — closer to 60% true completion: any 100 optional missions (there are 200-300+), 300 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges, 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, 15 of 18 card sets, 15 of 18 meditations, all 8 bank vaults and all 39 gang operations. Save this for last; most of it lands while you earn the other trophies.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.missableNote: No. Stunts stay available in free-roam after the story.
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts in the game. There are four kinds: 130 stunt jumps off ramps, 202 flights under bridges, 40 knife flights between buildings and 25 base jumps. Mix them freely and pick the easiest — flying under bridges is the quickest. Track progress by region under Progress, Activities, Stunts, and on the map under Exploration, Stunt Spots, where each stunt keeps its own name and marker. The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past 250.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.missableNote: No. Activities stay available in free-roam after the story.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a car race / race challenge / Top Fun drone race, and performing a stunt. Check them under Touch Pad, Progress, Activities — scrolling over each type shows how many you have done — and filter the map for Activities (blue dumbbell icon) to find them. You will do one of each almost by accident while chasing the other trophies.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.missableNote: No. Shooting ranges stay open in free-roam after the story.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 shooting range challenges across the 12 range locations, including Rodgers Ranch & Shooting Range in Port Gellhorn. The medals are not too hard, and range practice also levels up your Focus, which helps Gunslinger later. Do the ranges as you find them rather than leaving all 42 for the end.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.missableNote: No. Drone races stay available in free-roam after the story.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations (42 drone races in total). You only need one win per location, not every race. Drone racing also counts toward the race activity type for Master of None.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.missableNote: No. Races stay available in free-roam after the story.
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races out of the 40 unique race locations. Winning the same race 20 times does not count — each win has to be a race you have not won before. Mix car races, race challenges and drone races; the wins stack with Top Fun and Master of None.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.missableNote: No. Cal's fishing questline stays available after the story.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he texts you a fishing location marked with a purple icon on the map. Follow his fishing questline from there. Fishing also counts as one of the 9 activity types for Master of None.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.missableNote: No. Arcade games stay playable after the story.
trophies.guide: Finish any one of the 4 arcade games (called Video Games in-game): Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind, playable on the TV at home by interacting with the controllers, and Bang For Your Buck at arcade machines around the world. You must reach the end of the game — finish all of its levels at least once. You do not need to beat its challenges. Pick whichever game you like best.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.missableNote: No. Andy's questline stays available after the story.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's last mission. Her questline is Lucia-only and gets marked automatically in Chapter 3: while playing as Lucia you get a call from Andy, then she texts her home address in Belville. Complete her 5 quests — Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1-3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass — and the trophy pops on the last one.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.missableNote: No. Kenton returns in Chapters 2-3 and his quests stay available after the story.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's last mission. His questline gets marked automatically in Chapter 1: a while after the mission Island Dreams he calls you and is marked by the green KR icon in Key Lento. He sends you diving for treasure at 7 shipwrecks — he marks purple treasure-chest icons on the map, you dig the treasure from the ocean floor with the metal detector and bring it back. After the first set he calls you back for more. Kenton goes away after Chapter 1 but returns in Chapters 2-3 (playing as Jason, call Brian to hurry the text). Track it under Progress, Characters, Kenton Rees.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.missableNote: No. Billy's questline stays available after the story.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's last mission. His questline gets marked automatically after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Complete his 5 quests — Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes — and the trophy pops on the last one.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.missableNote: No. Strangers & Freaks stay in the open world after the story. One single-source caution (TechWiser, via CryptoGames) says some stranger chains have windows tied to story progress — start them when they unlock, to be safe.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers. Only certain questlines count — the named side characters (Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy, Eddie and others) do not count toward this one. Confirmed counting strands so far: Kirk (Skunk Ape hunts), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (street races) and Pilot Pete (deliveries); more are still being confirmed. Track your count in the trophy list itself, and start each strand as soon as it appears.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.missableNote: No. Randy's wish list stays available after the story.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's last mission. His questline, Randy's Wish List, gets marked automatically after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for him and unlock the Key Cloner. He then wants 16 sports cars delivered to his garage (green RK icon, west Vice City): Zorrusso (already delivered in the mission), Vitello, Infernus, Windsor Drop, Toros, Tempesta, Paragon, Jagular, Jubilee, Itali RSX, Growler, Gauntlet Hellfire, Furia, Dubsta, Banshee and Baller ST-D. Scan cars with the WAiNK app to check the list, steal them anywhere (they spawn often around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach), and deliver them in good condition for more money. Track the list under Map, Robberies, Randy's Wish List.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.missableNote: No. Tyrone's questline stays available after the story.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's last mission. His questline is Jason-only and gets marked automatically after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty: purple markers appear for the Synthetic Labs in Vice City. Destroy the labs in Take Out Kitty Litter, then Tyrone gives you Spin On This — shut the labs down — and the trophy pops when that quest ends.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missableNote: POSSIBLY MISSABLE — the only trophy flagged as possibly missable (PowerPyx, GTABase). The Chapter 1 balcony meditation at Jason's house disappears after Chapter 1, and it is unconfirmed whether the trophy needs it. Do it in Chapter 1 to be safe.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every one of the 18 meditation spots across 10 locations. Meditating with both Jason and Lucia at the same spot counts as +2, and you cannot finish the last one until both characters can play together (after Chapter 2, Coffee Break). Track it under Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations. THE WARNING: in Chapter 1, the morning after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen — she says she is going to meditate, walks to the balcony, and you must follow her and choose Accept. That session raises the counter by 1 but is not marked as a meditation spot, so nobody has confirmed whether the trophy needs it. PowerPyx's author did it and then earned the trophy. Do it in Chapter 1 — there is no mission replay, so a missed one means a new playthrough.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.missableNote: No. Bret's questline stays available after the story.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret Vogel. His questline is Jason-only and gets marked after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break: while playing as Jason you get a text from Bret that starts Veteran Hunted in Lummox County. He then marks hunting spots with purple icons — hunt the animals he requests and bring them to him. His first quest gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69 (retrievable from any Ammu-Nation weapon locker). One clean shot leaves the animal pristine and pays more, but it is not required. Which exact animal pops the trophy is still being confirmed. Track the hunts under Map, Activities, Target Deck — all 15 Target Decks count toward 100% anyway.

trophies.name: Don’t Touch My Deck
trophies.missableNote: No. Cards stay collectible in free-roam after the story.
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 of the 18 collectible card sets scattered across Leonida. You do not need all 18 — only 3 for this trophy, and 15 of 18 for the 100% checklist. Pick up cards as you explore and use a set-locations guide to finish the sets you are closest to completing first.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.missableNote: No. WAiNK spots stay scannable in free-roam after the story.
trophies.guide: Scan 100 locations with the WAiNK app — hold Up then R1 to scan what you are looking at. There are more than 100 to find, so any 100 count: 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and the No Flusher tags among them. Scan everything unusual as you travel and the trophy lands on its own.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.missableNote: No. Challenges stay available in free-roam after the story.
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges. The 100% checklist needs any 70 of 80, so this trophy pops automatically on the way there. View and track them under Progress, Challenges — scrolling over a challenge shows a Completed checkmark. Most complete naturally while you work on the other trophies; leave this for one of your last trophies, then pick the easiest and quickest of the ones you have left.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.missableNote: No. Wanted levels can be raised and lost again any time in free-roam.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, reach a 4-star wanted level and then escape the red heat zone entirely. You can only do this after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when Jason and Lucia can free-roam together — call your partner by holding Right and pressing Triangle. Cause carnage until you hit 4 stars, then break out on a fast sports motorcycle and cut through traffic; if a helicopter chases you, shoot it down. The easiest escape is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County, where cops struggle to follow and the helicopter cannot see you. The trophy pops after you drive out of the red heat zone, not the flashing search area. It also comes automatically during the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is, since bank vault robberies always trigger 4 stars.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.missableNote: No. Shops can be robbed again any time in free-roam.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops back-to-back without losing your wanted level. Only possible after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break (call your partner with hold Right + Triangle). Hit 3 robbery targets — green icons on the map — while staying chased the whole time: keep the red/blue flashing wanted level, not the red heat level. Bring an armored vest and sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation, plus Zombix or Adrenaline for healing. A good spot is the 3 jewelry stores in the north of Vice City (available after the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs): rob a couple of items in each store and break the back-room safe with sticky bombs. The pop is delayed about half a minute after leaving the 3rd shop — if it does not pop, hit a 4th shop and keep going.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.missableNote: No. Vehicles keep spawning in free-roam after the story.
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. The game has 557 vehicles at launch (cars, bikes, boats, helicopters, planes). The fast way is the WAiNK app on your phone — hold Up to open it instantly, look at a vehicle and hold R1 to scan it. Scanning is enough; you do not need to drive them. Stand on a busy road and scan everything passing by. Check your totals under Touch Pad, Progress, Vehicles. The 100% checklist needs 200 of the 277 base models scanned, so this trophy comes automatically on that road.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.missableNote: No. Combat Focus can be used again any time in free-roam.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Activate it with L3 + R3 while aiming a firearm: time slows and vulnerable spots are highlighted, draining the purple focus bar under your health and stamina. Buff your focus first — eat or drink, wash your face or shower at home — and take Adrenaline (hold L1, press Triangle) to stretch the slow time. Line up 5 enemies, ideally criminals at a gang operation, wear body armor from Ammu-Nation, and use an accurate full-auto rifle like the Duke 556. It does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has 4 levels (check Touch Pad, Jason & Lucia, Focus, purple eye icon) and levels up from shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots — by the endgame you will likely earn this naturally.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.missableNote: No. The airport planes stay stealable in free-roam after the story.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane that is docked to a departure terminal at VCIA (Vice City International Airport) and fly away with it. It must be a plane connected to a passenger boarding bridge — the planes parked on the airfield do not count. Easiest is the plane at departure terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence around the airfield, head straight for it, and use the stairs by the boarding bridge — the door leads directly into the plane. Go upstairs, enter the cockpit, drive the plane backward to the airstrip, take off and fly at least 1 km (0.6 miles) from the airport before it pops. You can also walk in through the terminal on foot, but the airfield route is faster.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.missableNote: No. The tanks stay at the air base in free-roam after the story.
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank (a Rhino). They stand in the south of Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. Drive through the gate — or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance — get in a tank and shoot enemies until the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.missableNote: No. Jewelry stores can be robbed again any time in free-roam.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs — it unlocks the Snap Gun for silently lockpicking alarmed doors, and jewelry store robberies themselves (green icons in unfogged map areas). Enter through the back door and use the Snap Gun when prompted instead of kicking the door (kicking triggers the alarm). The Snap Gun stays in your inventory permanently. Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code and loot the safe. A good location is Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.missableNote: No. Bank vaults stay robbable in free-roam after the story.
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is (Wait at the Cafe), which is marked automatically from story progress: tail a security van until it stops at a bank, wait for the guard to carry a briefcase of cash in and open the vault, then go in fast and rob it — bring your partner and hold Right to hand off a bag, since you cannot carry it all. After that quest, pay Yasmani (the fence from Chapter 3) $10,000 per tip about security vans — finish his Payday Loans quests first if you have not. Follow the purple-marked vans to the bank. Robbing a vault instantly gives a 4-star wanted level, so escape on a fast motorcycle, then switch cars to become unrecognizable. There are 8 large bank jobs in total: 5 for this trophy, all 8 for 100%, paying up to $205,000 per bank.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.missableNote: No. Armored trucks keep driving around Vice City in free-roam.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. It pops automatically in the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is, the same mission that unlocks bank vault robberies — tailing the truck to the bank and robbing its vault counts. To get it earlier, find an armored truck driving around Vice City near banks, block its path, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open (sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests). The trophy unlocks only after you escape the red heat radius — a Pay 'n' Spray helps.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.missableNote: No. The map stays explorable in free-roam after the story.
trophies.guide: Fully unfog the whole map of Leonida — every region revealed. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every area that is still black fog until the entire map is visible. Do this early and the map stops hiding activity icons, meditation spots and collectibles from you.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.missableNote: No. Gang operations stay robbable in free-roam after the story.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 illegal gang operations in total: 1 per gang for this trophy, all 39 for the 100% checklist. They are marked by yellow icons on the map when you go near them, and many get marked automatically from story progress. Track each gang under Progress, Gangs — scrolling over a gang shows how many of its operations you have robbed, in the bottom right.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.missableNote: No evidence of missability. Method unconfirmed at launch — see the guide.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED AT LAUNCH: PowerPyx lists this trophy's unlock method as currently unknown, and no other launch guide had confirmed it either. The description itself is the only lead: order a cocktail at a bar with a view over Ocean Beach. Try the beachfront bars on Ocean Beach in Vice City and order a drink while looking out at the water. Do not grind this blindly — check a current guide once players confirm the exact spot, and treat any method that cites no source as a guess.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.missableNote: No. The showroom car stays stealable in free-roam after the story.
trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City and drive it straight through the showroom window. You can only steal it after obtaining the Key Cloner in the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS (Steal the Zorrusso for Randy). Hack into the car, drive forward through the window, and keep driving — the pop is slightly delayed and lands after you are further down the street. Only this blue Banshee works, not any other car: it is an easter egg for the Banshee from GTA III.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.missableNote: No. If you miss an item, the robbery icon respawns later and you can take what is left.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn — one of the gang operations. Buy sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation first; you need them to blow the safe. The alley is marked automatically during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling. Inside, take the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun Gutterball Moreland 850 on the table in the north-east corner, and loot the safe in the north-east hallway office with sticky bombs (all three have golden icons). The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you pick up the third item, and killing the enemies is not required. If you miss one, wait for the robbery icon to respawn and take the rest later.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.missableNote: No. Strength can be trained any time in free-roam after the story.
trophies.guide: Reach maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Check your level under Touch Pad, Jason & Lucia, then scroll to Strength (heart icon). Only possible after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters. Raise strength by working out — buy a fitness club membership and always train together with your partner (hold Right and press Triangle to call them): while one character works out, the other completes their training automatically, so you progress twice as fast. Filter the map for fitness clubs under Activities (dumbbell icon); there are many across Vice City, and you can also work out at home after the story.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.missableNote: No. Profile actions keep counting in free-roam after the story.
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile. Track the count by clicking the trophy in the trophy list, and turn on profile notifications in Settings, UI, HUD Notifications, Criminal Profile, so a little demon face appears on the right of the screen whenever an action counts. The five profiles are Professional (stealthy objectives and robberies, destroying evidence, clean escapes), Hardened (incapacitating without killing), Violent (killing enemies and civilians), Psycho (killing large numbers of cops and civilians, driving over gravestones) and Irredeemable — a permanent status from excessive violence, so do not push that far. It happens passively while you work on the other trophies; if anything is left at the end, farm it by running over civilians and cops with a car.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.missableNote: No evidence of missability. Method unconfirmed at launch — see the guide.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED AT LAUNCH: PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the Prologue. The description — second time's the charm — suggests failing something once and succeeding on the retry, but no launch guide had confirmed the exact trigger. Do not grind this blindly; play the story and the Payday Loans content normally, and check a current guide once players confirm it.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.missableNote: No evidence of missability. Method unconfirmed at launch — see the guide.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED AT LAUNCH: PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to be from a UFO questline. The description suggests witnessing something strange — most likely a UFO event somewhere in Leonida. No launch guide had confirmed the exact trigger or location. Keep playing, watch for strange lights or events in the open world, and check a current guide once players pin it down.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.missableNote: No evidence of missability. Method unconfirmed at launch — see the guide.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED AT LAUNCH: PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to be from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle. The working theory is a melee attack — a kick — from a moving motorcycle that knocks someone over, bowling-pin style. No launch guide had confirmed the exact move, so try melee kicks from a motorcycle at enemies and check a current guide once players confirm it.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.missableNote: No. Marked bills keep coming from robberies in free-roam after the story.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 in marked bills through your contacts. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew), which unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer you need to launder them. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and bring the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The total counts across all robberies, not in one trip. It comes naturally while you do the robberies for 100%: a single bank vault pays up to $205,000, but those only open after the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.missableNote: No. Shops stay open in free-roam after the story.
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across all types of shops. The fastest way is the expensive stuff: guns, car mods and tattoos. The map holds 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair and beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios and 15 electronics stores — kitting out a car and a loadout clears the total quickly.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.missableNote: No. Garages stay buyable in free-roam after the story.
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages (the 4 story-related garages do not count). They cost $160,000 in total and become available after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses), when the Vice City Real Estate app is installed on your phone — buy them through the app. Robberies are the quick way to the money, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3-4. Garages also matter for On the Spot: each one adds parking spots to register vehicles.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.missableNote: No. Vehicles keep spawning in free-roam after the story.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app is installed on your phone after the Chapter 2 mission Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses) — it lets you register stolen vehicles and have them delivered to you anywhere. First buy enough garages (see Little Boxes): each garage adds parking spots, and you need the space before you can register. Drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray then Register in his garage. At first he only takes vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registering costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes.
